2607.08402.title: Swapping Faces, Saving Features: A Dual-Purpose Pipeline for Pedestrian Privacy in ITS
2607.08402.paper_summary: Large-scale and diverse datasets are needed to train AI models to take real-time decisions for autonomous vehicles (AVs), an intelligent transportation system (ITS) application. Pedestrian intention and trajectory prediction are critical models used in AVs, requiring datasets involving diverse pedestrian images. Unrestricted access to these datasets imposes serious security risks, like identity theft and pedestrian tracking. The challenge is to apply privacy preservation procedures while maintaining the image attributes needed to train the models. Existing privacy methods may preserve the pedestrian's privacy, but degrade the image usability, which hinders the models' effectiveness. This work's focus is to implement a five-stage pipeline to protect pedestrians' privacy through face swapping while keeping the essential facial attributes intact. It should be tailored to satisfy the privacy needs of the Egy-DRiVeS dataset. Moreover, Roop and Ghost-v2 face-swapping models are evaluated. Provenly, Roop outperforms Ghost-v2 in various aspects, as will be discussed. Consequently, Roop is the face-swapping model to be used in the pipeline to strike the balance between pedestrian privacy via identity concealment and data usability via facial attribute preservation.
2607.08402.paper_summary_zh: 大型且多樣化的數據集是訓練人工智慧模型以便為自主車輛（AVs）做出即時決策所需的，這是一種智慧交通系統（ITS）應用。行人意圖和軌跡預測是自主車輛中使用的關鍵模型，這需要涉及多樣化行人圖像的數據集。對這些數據集的無限制訪問會帶來嚴重的安全風險，例如身份盜竊和行人追蹤。挑戰在於在保持訓練模型所需的圖像屬性的同時，應用隱私保護程序。現有的隱私方法可能會保護行人的隱私，但會降低圖像的可用性，這妨礙了模型的有效性。本工作的重點是實施一個五階段的流程，通過面部交換來保護行人的隱私，同時保持基本的面部屬性不變。這應該針對滿足Egy-DRiVeS數據集的隱私需求。此外，還評估了Roop和Ghost-v2面部交換模型。證明Roop在各個方面都優於Ghost-v2，這將在後文中討論。因此，Roop是該流程中將用於在身份隱藏的行人隱私和面部屬性保護的數據可用性之間取得平衡的面部交換模型。
